violations.description: SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): The temperature of the rinse cycle of the heat sanitizing dish machine in the ware washing area noted not adequate to achieve final sanitization. A critical item re-inspection will occur on or before 11/12/26. If additional time is required to correct the violation the inspector must be contacted to delay re-inspection. | SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): An inadequate amount of chlorine sanitizer was noted in the final rinse of the dish machine in the bar area. A critical item re-inspection will occur on or before 11/12/26. If additional time is required to correct the violation the inspector must be contacted to delay re-inspection.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): The hand washing lavatory in the bar noted being used for other than hand washing. One of the hand sink in the bar area needs to be designated for ONLY handwashing. It is strongly recommended to label the sink as a hand sink and instruct all staff to only use that sink for handwashing. Handsinks cannot be used as a dump sink they are only for hands. Critical violation corrected through training on the topic.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Magnetic knife block prep line cutting board and microwave interiors noted not properly maintained.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - DESIGN (2 pts): Cutting boards on the prep cooler in the kitchen noted not in good repair.
PREMISES (1 pts): Mop noted not hung.

FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Walls in the salad prep area noted in need of cleaning. Walls in the mop sink noted with screw holes in need of caulking/sealing. Some floor tiles and grout in the kitchen noted in need of repair.

CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Bagged raw beef and pork cubes were observed stored in the open-top prep cooler. Raw meat juices presumed to have leaked from the bags were noted on adjacent food containers and pans. Lettuce intended for burgers was stored directly next to the raw meats creating a risk of cross-contamination. Additionally storing the raw meats in this location presents a risk of raw meat juices contaminating the prep cutting board and other food items during handling. Raw animal foods must be stored in a manner that prevents contamination of ready-to-eat foods and food-contact surfaces. Upon notification of the violation the raw meats were removed from the open-top cooler and all potentially contaminated food items were voluntarily discarded. The critical violation was corrected at the time of inspection through these actions and employee education regarding proper raw meat storage and cross-contamination prevention. | CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw meat noted stored over vegetables in the walk-in cooler. Raw meats are not to be stored above foods that do not have the same or higher required final cooking temperature. Critical violation corrected by moving the meat to a new location.

CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Salmon and tuna noted be stored in there sealed vacuum bags. All fish and seafood must be completely removed from there vacuum sealed bags while thawing or being stored under refrigeration.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Magnetic knife block can opener microwave interior and some cooler interiors noted not properly cleaned/maintained.
IN-USE UTENSILS (1 pts): In - use utensil noted being stored with the handle laying in the bulk seasoning bins etc Use a scoop with handle.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Ceiling in the kitchen around vents noted in need of cleaning.

CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw chicken noted stored above raw scallops and fish. Raw meats are always to be stored according to final cooking temperature. From bottom to top: chicken beef pork seafood and all ready-to-eat/pre-cooked on top. Corrected on the spot by rearranging the speed rack.

COLD AND HOT STORAGE EQUIPMENT (4 pts): Prep cooler in the facility being used for cold holding temp of 41 degrees F was not functioning adequately. Thermostat had been bumped or turned to too warm of temperature. The thermostat was adjusted from the cool range to the normal range (colder) to correct the violation. Also the table top steamwell with marinara and utensils noted at 123?F. The thermostat was turned up to correct this violation. If the steamwell is not running as usual it should be repaired or replaced.

SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): The temperature of the rinse cycle of the heat sanitizing dish machine noted not adequate to achieve final sanitization. Critical violation corrected on the spot. Dishwasher repair man came out while inspector was still present.
CONTAMINATION FROM WIPING CLOTHS (2 pts): In a couple locations wiping cloths were noted laying on counter in kitchen.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - DESIGN (1 pts): Cooler/freezer door gaskets and interior of microwave door noted not in good repair.
PREMISES (1 pts): Mop not hung. Mop noted in the mop wringer.
